description: Validates API readiness, health contracts, route semantics, and runtime hygiene through api-health.

levels.name: API readiness unavailable
levels.description: API Health cannot resolve or inspect the target scenario.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve a readable target scenario and classify API applicability.

levels.name: API readiness inspectable
levels.description: The target is readable and API Health can report applicability without false clean passes.
levels.next_unlock: Satisfy lifecycle and health contract checks.

levels.name: API readiness baseline enforced
levels.description: Provider-owned API lifecycle, health, HTTP, runtime, and fixability checks are implemented.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve all required provider-owned findings.

levels.name: API readiness clean
levels.description: API Health has no required provider-owned findings for the target scenario.

capabilities.label: Target Resolution
capabilities.description: Scenario lookup, API surface discovery, and honest no-API degradation.

levels.name: No API target
levels.description: The target scenario cannot be resolved or has no readable source tree.
levels.capability_summary: API Health cannot inspect a target scenario.
levels.next_unlock: A readable scenario directory with service metadata.

levels.name: Target readable
levels.description: The target resolves, but API surface applicability is unknown or absent.
levels.capability_summary: API Health can read the target and classify API applicability.
levels.next_unlock: A declared or discoverable API surface, or an explicit no-API non-applicability result.

levels.name: API surface classified
levels.description: API applicability is known and no unevaluated target is reported as clean.
levels.capability_summary: API Health has an honest target-resolution result.

capabilities.label: API Lifecycle Contract
capabilities.description: Vrooli lifecycle health metadata, preflight ordering, and graceful server runner adoption.

levels.name: Lifecycle contract unavailable
levels.description: API lifecycle metadata or entrypoint source cannot be inspected.
levels.capability_summary: API lifecycle compatibility cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Readable .vrooli/service.json and API entrypoint source.

levels.name: Lifecycle inputs inspectable
levels.description: Lifecycle metadata and entrypoint source are inspectable.
levels.next_unlock: Standard API health metadata, preflight, and api-core/server adoption.

levels.name: Lifecycle baseline enforced
levels.description: The API is compatible with Vrooli lifecycle startup, health, and shutdown expectations.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum lifecycle-contract maturity.

levels.name: Lifecycle clean
levels.description: API lifecycle findings are clean.

capabilities.label: Health Runtime Contract
capabilities.description: Static and live validation of the standard /health readiness surface.

levels.name: Health contract unavailable
levels.description: The health endpoint cannot be inspected or probed.
levels.capability_summary: API health readiness cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: A declared /health endpoint and, for execution mode, a reachable lifecycle API.

levels.name: Health surface present
levels.description: A health surface is declared or detected, but schema/runtime findings remain.
levels.next_unlock: Schema-valid, lifecycle-reachable health response.

levels.name: Health response valid
levels.description: Static and live health checks satisfy API Health's readiness contract.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum health-runtime maturity.

levels.name: Health clean
levels.description: Health runtime findings are clean.
levels.capability_summary: API health runtime readiness is clean.

capabilities.label: HTTP Response Contract
capabilities.description: Low-ambiguity HTTP status, content-type, and route-version semantics.

levels.name: HTTP contract unavailable
levels.description: API routes and response paths cannot be inspected.
levels.next_unlock: Readable API route and handler source.

levels.name: HTTP surface inspectable
levels.description: Routes and response writers are inspectable.
levels.capability_summary: HTTP response contract inputs are visible.
levels.next_unlock: Status, content-type, and versioning findings resolved or explicitly non-applicable.

levels.name: HTTP baseline enforced
levels.description: First-party HTTP semantics are consistent for supported patterns.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum HTTP-response maturity.

levels.name: HTTP clean
levels.description: HTTP response contract findings are clean.

capabilities.label: Runtime Hygiene
capabilities.description: API-runtime timeout, close, context, cancellation, and structured logging discipline.

levels.name: Runtime hygiene unavailable
levels.description: API runtime source cannot be inspected.
levels.capability_summary: API runtime hygiene cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Readable API runtime source.

levels.name: Runtime source inspectable
levels.description: API runtime source is inspectable for supported hygiene checks.
levels.capability_summary: API runtime hygiene inputs are visible.
levels.next_unlock: Timeout, close, context, cancellation, and logging findings resolved.

levels.name: Runtime baseline enforced
levels.description: Supported API runtime hygiene checks are clean or explicitly non-applicable.
levels.capability_summary: API runtime hygiene baseline is enforced.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum runtime-hygiene maturity.

levels.name: Runtime clean
levels.description: Runtime hygiene findings are clean.

capabilities.label: Autofix Readiness
capabilities.description: Deterministic fix coverage and safe preview/apply behavior for unambiguous API Health findings.

levels.name: Fix contract unavailable
levels.description: Fixability declarations or the fix RPC are absent.
levels.next_unlock: Finding fix_class declarations and shared Fix RPC wiring.

levels.name: Fixability declared
levels.description: All findings declare fixability, but implemented fixers may be missing.
levels.next_unlock: Implemented fixers for every auto-fixable unambiguous finding.

levels.name: Fixers preview safely
levels.description: Implemented fixers support dry-run previews and explicit apply with idempotent results.
levels.capability_summary: Autofix behavior is safe for operators and agents.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum autofix maturity.

levels.name: Autofix clean
levels.description: Autofix declarations and implementations are complete for current findings.
levels.capability_summary: API Health autofix readiness is clean.

api_health.target_unresolved.reason: Choosing or creating the correct scenario target requires operator or calling-agent judgment.

api_health.api_surface_absent.reason: A scenario may intentionally have no API; adding one is a product architecture decision.

api_health.preflight_missing_or_late.reason: Moving or inserting preflight in api/main.go can depend on startup ordering and side effects.

api_health.server_runner_missing.reason: Migrating server startup to api-core/server.Run requires understanding handler construction and shutdown hooks.

api_health.health_probe_failed.reason: A failed live probe may require starting lifecycle services, fixing runtime dependencies, or repairing API code.

api_health.health_schema_invalid.reason: Repairing a malformed health payload can require changing the handler response model and dependency status semantics.

api_health.error_response_implicit_succe.reason: Choosing the correct error status and envelope can depend on API semantics.

api_health.unversioned_feature_endpoint.reason: Changing endpoint paths is an API compatibility decision.

api_health.http_client_unbounded.reason: Timeout values and client ownership depend on call semantics and retry policy.

api_health.request_context_dropped.reason: Correct context propagation can require changing service signatures across a call graph.

api_health.goroutine_not_cancellable.reason: Adding cancellation requires understanding goroutine ownership and shutdown semantics.

api_health.unstructured_api_logging.reason: Logging architecture and field vocabulary require local API design judgment.

api_health.autofix_contract_incomplete.reason: Building deterministic fixers is provider implementation work.
